HP_sweep.rule: max silhouette among configs within 0.05 of the best observed MEDIAN-node causal R2; ties -> smaller fp dim (revision 2; revision 1 used an absolute R2>=0.90 gate that was unsatisfiable in every experiment)
attribution.metric: kNN 3-fold CV accuracy from per-sample attribution map
label: MLP digits
seed_repeats.note: nmf_seed spread is expected to be ~0: bft initialises NMF with deterministic nndsvda when K <= min(n_samples, n_features), so random_state only affects mini-batch sampling. Quote the model_seed spread as the error bar.
